decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering business, and with an expanding firm and industry growth meeting aspirations, slack allows it to stay on the market while results mature.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy efficiency, so despite uncertain early results and only a brief website mention, management will keep it rather than start problemistic search.
The overflow flap gate is a multi-model product line with its own web page and lies close to the established offer, signalling commitment and performance consistent with aspirations.
